Narrative Shifts in Villeneuve’s Trilogy

The final trailer for Denis Villeneuve’s Dune: Part Three confirms that the film will deviate significantly from its source material, Frank Herbert’s Dune Messiah. While the book depicts Chani as a loyal partner to Paul Atreides, the film establishes her as a disillusioned, estranged figure actively working against his regime.

New Dynamics for the Atreides Lineage

A major departure involves Paul and Chani’s children, Leto II and Ghanima. In the adaptation, the twins appear as teenagers in opposition to their father, whereas the novels introduce them at different ages and roles. The trailer suggests Chani is collaborating with Paul’s enemies to seize control of the spice supply by capturing a sandworm. These changes indicate the film will explore a unique conflict regarding Paul’s legacy and power.
